A '''female human''' was a [[Jedi]] who was stationed at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] during the last days of the [[Clone Wars]]. When [[Order 66]] was enacted, she and a group of other Jedi helped bring the [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] to [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelleran Beq]], so they could escape from [[Coruscant]] in the middle of [[Operation: Knightfall]]. She was killed by [[clone trooper]]s during the siege.<ref name="Chapter 20" />
